name: @bffless/ce
description: Static Asset Hosting Platform - Self-contained platform for hosting images and static assets from CI/CD pipelines

scripts.dev:services:reset: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile postgres --profile supertokens down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml --profile postgres --profile supertokens up -d && sleep 5 && cd apps/backend && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.dev:dex: docker compose -f docker-compose.dex.yml up -d && echo 'Dex running at http://localhost:5556 — add as Generic OIDC in /admin/settings/auth (clientId: bffless-ce-dev, secret: dev-secret-change-me, discovery: http://localhost:5556/.well-known/openid-configuration)'
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.docker:reset:volumes: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d && sleep 10 && cd apps/backend && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.docker:reset:full: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose build && docker-compose up -d
